positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description:
Developed front-end of the reservation service for Open-Source Self-Driving CAR (OSCAR) project using Jekyll; used within SNU for research purposes.

Analyzed source code for Autoware (open-source) to identify and modify parameters that affected autonomous vehicles’ self-driving speed to handle unexpected collisions of vehicles on the track.

positions.title: Head Director and Instructor
positions.description:
Spearheaded team to host the 2018 Korean National Championship Tournament in Chadwick International; collaborated with VEX officials and school faculty to arrange logistics and technical setup.

Initiated 3-week summer program for female high school students in Chadwick International, teaching fundamentals of building VEX robots and coding in RobotC for autonomous programming.
